name: Comics, Daily
description: Today's comics on one page: The Far Side's daily panels in a row with their captions, then GoComics strips (Garfield, Calvin and Hobbes, Pearls Before Swine, or any other) and an archived Dilbert, full width and in your order. As many rows as fit without cutting one off. Pick the comics under Widgets → Admin pages → Comics, which every cell shows. Fetched in the background once a day (or with Fetch now); when a site blocks a download the last good strip stays up, a small note says so, and you can upload or import that day's strip.

settings.name: strips
settings.label: Strips
settings.help: In your order, top to bottom, under the Far Side. Switch a strip off to keep it in the list without showing it.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.help: The name the page's notes use. Leave it blank for the strip's own name.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Strip
fields.pattern_hint: a GoComics name like garfield (lower-case letters, digits and -), or dilbert
fields.help: The GoComics name, as in gocomics.com/<name>, or dilbert for the Dilbert archive.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Source
fields.help: Automatic downloads the strip each day. Manual upload shows the picture you uploaded or imported until you switch back to Automatic. Direct image URL downloads the Image URL each day instead (comic sites only: GoComics, amuniversal.com, The Far Side).

fields.name: image_url
fields.label: Image URL
fields.help: For Direct image URL, or for Import URL: any picture address on the web, downloaded once now and kept as a manual upload.

settings.name: far_side
settings.label: The Far Side
settings.help: Today's Far Side panels in a row above the strips.

settings.name: far_side_count
settings.label: Panels
settings.help: How many Far Side panels in the row, 1 to 4. A narrow cell shows fewer.

settings.name: captions
settings.label: Captions
settings.help: The caption under each Far Side panel.

settings.name: small_screens
settings.label: When they don't all fit

choices.label: Show as many as fit, taking turns with the rest
Show one at a time, taking turns

settings.help: On a small or landscape screen not every comic fits at a size you can read. Rather than shrink them or cut one off, the comics take turns: each refresh shows the next ones. The admin page's preview shows what each screen gets.

settings.name: gap_min
settings.label: Smallest gap
settings.help: How far the gap shrinks to fit one more strip before the last one is left out.

settings.name: gap
settings.label: Usual gap
settings.help: The space between rows, in pixels on a 1440 px wide panel; narrower cells scale it down.

settings.name: gap_max
settings.label: Largest gap
settings.help: How far the gap grows when there is spare height.

settings.name: status_note
settings.label: Status note
settings.help: A small line at the foot of the page naming any comic that couldn't be updated today.
